note: KOA Journey on the east side of Yankton, about 1 km north of the Missouri River with no river frontage. Pull-throughs up to 65 ft among young shade trees; tent sites and camping cabins; seasonal pool, jumping pillow, dog park. Lewis and Clark Lake is 6 mi west. --Claude
summary: KOA park page and booking form read through the headless browser. Year-round (limited amenities in winter), 50-amp FHU pull-throughs $46-49, summer peak dearest $60; passes the gate. Hookups/sites/booking re-sourced from note-derived to the operator; season, WiFi and fees written; note rewritten. Operator's 'banks of the Missouri River' wording checked on imagery: the river is ~1.2 km south - stays not waterfront.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest RV electric night Pull Thru 50/30/20 A FHU $46 (May 18 and Sep 14, 2027); summer peak $49 cheapest / $60 dearest (July 13). Good Sam false; KOA Rewards 10% exists but isn't needed.

WATERFRONT (contrary operator claim, re-audited): the KOA page says 'Nestled along the scenic banks of the Missouri River', but imagery puts the river ~1.2 km south across fields and woods. Stays not waterfront; the note now says so.
LONG-STAY (passes): nightly booking online is the main product; 'Extended Stays' is one of several ways to stay. Google 4.5 from 248 reviews; RV Life 4.5, $$$.
PIN: fine - on the north row of sites.
